# Dive Life

> PADI 5-Star dive center in Playa del Carmen offering boutique scuba diving, cenote diving, snorkeling, sailing, and ocean adventures across the Riviera Maya.

Dive Life operates from Kanai complex and Grand Velas Riviera Maya, with pickup for external guests in Playa del Carmen. Small groups, premium equipment, expert PADI-certified instructors.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of experiences, safety standards, and locations.
- [Experiences](/experiences): Full catalog of dives, snorkeling tours, cenote trips, sailing, and watersports with prices.
- [About](/about): Mission, values, team, and PADI 5-Star safety standards.
- [Location](/location): Kanai, Grand Velas, and BlueBay access; directions and pickup information.
- [FAQs](/faqs): Common questions about certifications, gear, ages, and booking.

- [Contact](/contact): WhatsApp, email, and inquiry form.
